# TERRAN upstream attribution

Upstream: https://github.com/NanpengYu/TERRAN

Pinned revision: `926665870d08e24b1acea33a57f1412c96376758`.

License: Apache License 2.0; the complete pinned upstream LICENSE is included here. The pinned repository has no NOTICE file. The upstream citation and authors remain available in the linked public repository; attribution is not anonymized.

The `models/nets/attention_model` tree and model wrapper derive from this public implementation. This benchmark adaptation uses the shared EVRPTW-D/B environment and observation schema, full charging, canonical physical masks, cached decoding, and additional stable-cost critic support. It is not an unchanged reproduction of upstream training. Files changed from the pinned revision carry a modification notice. Local PPO, reward, training-data and environment adapters are identified separately in the source.

Public upstream file hashes were retrieved and matched against their Git blob IDs during release preparation. Three model files are unchanged; seven are adapted. The detailed private provenance audit retains original source locations without exposing workstation metadata.
